mentions.name: IronCalc
mentions.description: A spreadsheet engine that is adding internationalization and localization support, aiming to handle locale and language differences correctly where Excel's handling is a nightmare. An open pull request implements the changes and a public testing instance lets people try them.
mentions.problem: Internationalization and localization in spreadsheets is a rabbit hole and a nightmare in Excel, so getting it right is a big opportunity.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm in crunch mode doing the internationalization and localization of my spreadsheet engine. This is a rabbit hole and a nightmare in Excel, so a big opportunity for us to get this right.
